name: ModernJEV-Decide-Preview
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-30. 2026-10-29 image triage: every figure on this card was opened and read. The only image on the card is architecture.svg, an encoder-plus-scalar-head diagram referenced from the architecture description. It carries no scores; the card's two numbers come from an HTML table already recorded. Legitimate zero. The repo api reports no PNG/JPG siblings at all.

benchmarks.name: Next action (1,158 held-out decisions)
benchmarks.config: Card '## Evaluation' comparison table | Comparison | Next action (1,158 cases) | Tool selection (542 cases) |: 'ModernJEV-Decide-Preview 73.40% 62.18%' vs 'ModernBERT + untrained scalar head, seed 42 42.83% 0.74%'. CAVEAT: the printed base is the base encoder with a randomly initialised scalar head, which the card itself says 'is not a trained decision classifier', so the comparison measures the trained head as much as the encoder. Eval is the authors' own AgentToolDecisions official test split; no When2Call labels were used for training or checkpoint selection. Constant-majority reference on this task is 53.20%.

benchmarks.name: Tool selection (542 held-out decisions)
benchmarks.config: Same table, tool-selection column: this 62.18% vs base+random head 0.74%. Same caveats. The stronger allowed-choice training-frequency baseline is 22.88%, so the margin over a real baseline is smaller than the printed one. When2Call (unseen family) is BELOW its majority reference: 34.39% vs 35.46%.
